camera: Flat front-facing UI; a parchment notice banner over the dimmed dungeon screen. Region terrain behind is a flat top-down painted map; hero and henchman art are painted cards; no 3D.

hudLayout.topThird: The top ~16% is a solid black empty band (missing header). Below it the khaki location tab bar: wide left tab with a farmhouse icon and the dungeon name in pale capitals with a crimson badge number, then four square tabs (ochre boots, green tree, two dark locked rocks). Under it the region terrain strip (maroon snow-capped mountains, ochre plains, conifers) with three tall hero slots: two teal-framed filled slots (purple-lit dwarf storm mage, crimson-lit elf warrior) with crimson X buttons, small gold coin '+1' badges at their top-left and dark cooldown number badges; a small painted farm-girl henchman with a rooster overlaps the first slot's bottom-left with a gold 'x2' multiplier; slot 3 empty grey with a big plus.
hudLayout.middleThird: A wide parchment-cream notice banner (~80% width, ~44%-55% of height) with a thin amber/brass rim: a bold white headline and four lines of centred white body text. Behind and below it the dungeon level list begins: each level row has a purple-framed henchman card at left (level label, crimson 'UPGRADE AVAILABLE' tag, tool icon with a multiplier), a wide progress bar (teal fill) with the level name and an income amount with a small tool icon, under it a wide amber hire button with the henchman name and four cost chips with resource icons; at right two square resource chips with counts and crimson badges, and a teal MAX HIRE button beneath.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Three full level rows stacked (two with partly filled teal progress bars; the third locked with a dark portrait, an amber play-arrow chevron, and a grey bar). Under the rows a centred two-line grey unlock requirement message and the top of an amber progress bar with a fraction, cut off at the bottom; below it a dark navy field.

playspaceType: event-ended notice over dungeon level list
keyElements: parchment 'The event has ended' notice banner centred
LOCAL FARM tab bar with badge
three hero slots with X buttons, +1 coin badges, cooldown numbers, x2 farm-girl henchman
level rows: purple henchman card, teal progress bar, amber hire button with four cost chips
right-side resource chips with crimson count badges and teal MAX HIRE buttons
unlock requirement text and progress bar at the bottom
uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice chrome in purple, teal, amber, crimson and khaki with lighter bevel rims and darker warm front lips; small crimson square count badges; glossy painted resource icons with thin self-coloured rims; a flat parchment notice panel with a brass rim. Crisp programmatic engine chrome, dense but evenly spaced.
colorPalette: Warm parchment-cream banner as the brightest block in the centre, surrounded by saturated amber hire buttons, teal bars and purple card frames, earthy terrain above and a dark navy field below; the whole background is dimmed under a translucent overlay.
mood: Rewarding and transitional — one event closes, the next begins.
composition: The bright parchment banner sits dead centre across the seam between hero slots and level rows; the repeating three-tier level rows create a strong vertical rhythm below it.
